name: Hive 1.2.1
notes: Runtime reliability: a per-runtime Test button (Settings -> Models) sends a trivial prompt through the real dispatch path and reports pass/fail + latency, so a CLI that isn't logged in or hangs shows up immediately instead of as a silent stall. Turns now have a backstop timeout (a wedged agent surfaces an error and frees the chat instead of thinking forever; override with HIVE_TURN_TIMEOUT_SECS). And saved agents (Settings -> Agents) can now be attached to a chat from the Tools pane's Add-an-agent picker, so a template you define once is usable in any workspace.
